sections.h2: Selling a house in Lake Jackson
sections.html:
Lake Jackson is a planned city, so many houses sit on curved streets under mature oaks. Buyers often care about the lot, the trees and the drainage as much as the floor plan. Population was 26,386 in 2000, and a seller who can explain the neighborhood and the Brazoria County tax picture tends to get fewer surprises late in the deal.

You have two basic routes. Listing with an agent puts the house in front of the widest pool, at the price of fix-up work, open houses and a lender's approval process. An investor offer is faster and asks nothing of you in the way of repairs. Work out your take-home on each after the mortgage, the tax bill and settlement charges, and let your calendar break the tie.

Before a single lot was cleared, the planner drew the whole town on paper and asked crews to spare as many trees as they could. Streets are called drives, ways and streets. Drives circle the outskirts as through routes, streets end at drives or ways, and ways lead downtown. Street names come from flowers, fruits, shrubs and trees. Jackson Lake, Flagg Lake and two other lakes sit inside the town.

  • Curved streets give each lot its own shape, so check survey lines before listing.
  • Oak roots can reach slabs and sewer pipes, so have an inspector check both.
  • Older homes near downtown pre-date later codes, so gather any permit records you have.
  • A house near one of the lakes should come with drainage records and its flood zone designation from the city or county, since lenders ask for them.

sections.h2: Houses from the postwar boom and later
sections.html:
Lake Jackson began in 1941 and grew in stages: 2,897 residents in 1950, 11,090 in 1958, 19,102 in 1980 and 22,776 in 1990. Your house could be from the first postwar years or from a far later decade; the appraisal record shows the build year.

Older houses can carry foundation, plumbing and wiring questions. A pre-listing inspection costs less than a failed contract, and the report gives buyers a baseline they can trust. Shoppers also want to know which Brazosport Independent School District campus serves the address, and the zoning on the lot is worth confirming before you advertise.

Brazoria County gives owners several ways to spread a bill, and a buyer may use one of them after closing. If one is active on your house, tell the closing office so the payoff figure is right.

Payment options offered by the Brazoria County Tax Office
Payment optionRule
Split paymentHalf by November 30, remainder by June 30 of the next year, no penalty or interest
Over 65, disabled or disabled veteranFour equal installments due January 31, March 31, May 31 and July 31
Disaster area installmentSame four dates, for damaged property in a declared disaster area
DeferralElderly or disabled owners sign an affidavit, interest of 5 percent a year applies
Partial paymentsAccepted in any amount, penalty and interest apply to the rest

Details are on the Brazoria County Tax Office payment page.

sections.h2: Selling with deferred or unpaid taxes
sections.html:
A deferral ends the day the owner stops owning and living in the house, so closing a sale makes the whole deferred amount, interest included, payable. Debt that stays unpaid can draw penalties and legal action from the taxing units.

Each January 1 a lien for that year's taxes attaches to the property. Request a certificate from the Brazoria County Tax Office that lists every account tied to your parcel, and get it to the closing office ahead of time. Back taxes are paid from the sale proceeds, and the figure is much easier to live with when you saw it before signing day.

sections.h2: Texas tax dates for Lake Jackson owners
sections.html:
The calendar comes from state law, and Brazoria County does the collecting. A bill still open after January 31 starts accruing penalty and interest the next day, and the penalty climbs to 12 percent on July 1.

  • File a homestead application by April 30; school districts take $140,000 off a homestead's value.
  • Value protests go to the appraisal review board by May 15, with extra time if your notice came late.
  • Bills are mailed in October and are payable on receipt.
  • Older or disabled owners may request a school tax ceiling too.

The state publishes the full details on the Comptroller deadlines page and the exemptions page.

On the coast, shoppers start with the roof, drainage, windows and foundation. Ask the city's permit office before any major job, and save invoices and permits for the inspector.

When repairs cost too much or time is short, an investor can purchase the house untouched and do the work later. Put that offer next to a repaired listing, subtracting commissions and the months you would keep paying the bills.

The Brazoria County clerk records deeds for Lake Jackson land. Expect a records management fee of up to $10, a records archive fee of up to $10 and a $2.00 technology fee, all stacked on the per-page charge in the county clerk manual.

A notary or similar officer has to acknowledge your signature before the clerk will accept the deed. Filing is handled by the closing office; you only need to confirm the names and legal description match your own purchase deed.

sections.h2: Who to call about your Brazoria County account
sections.html:
Start with the Brazoria County Tax Office, which collects the bill, and the Brazoria County Appraisal District, which handles exemptions. Ask each for a written account summary that shows the exemption status, any installment plan or deferral on file, and any back taxes.

Pass both summaries along the day a contract is signed. With an installment plan open, settle early who clears the remaining balance, the buyer or your proceeds. Payoff figures change with the closing date, so request an updated figure for the closing day.

sections.h2: Steps from first offer to closing
sections.html:
1. Pull together the deed, your newest tax statement, a mortgage payoff statement and any repair or permit records.
  2. Ask for an investor offer and, if you want, a listing agent's price, and line up what each leaves you.
  3. Choose a title company and send it the county tax certificate.
  4. Sign the deed in front of a notary.
  5. Read the closing statement to see how the year's tax and any plan balance were split.

A sale to a cash buyer avoids the mortgage underwriting, the appraisal wait and most repair haggling, which shortens the calendar. You also skip prepping the house for showings.

faqs.q: Who bills the tax on a Lake Jackson house?
faqs.a: The Brazoria County Tax Office sends the bill, using the certified roll from the Brazoria County Appraisal District. Mailing happens in October.

faqs.q: When are Lake Jackson taxes delinquent?
faqs.a: Anything still unpaid after January 31 is late, and penalty and interest start accruing February 1. The penalty reaches 12 percent on July 1.

faqs.q: Can I pay Brazoria County taxes in installments?
faqs.a: In several cases, yes. A split plan runs half by November 30 and half by June 30, and owners 65 or older, disabled owners and a disabled veteran can use four installments.

faqs.q: Does selling end a Brazoria County tax deferral?
faqs.a: Yes. The deferred taxes and interest are due once you no longer own and live in the home.

faqs.q: Do I need to repair my Lake Jackson house before selling?
faqs.a: No. An investor buys the house in its current shape and lowers the offer to cover the work. Compare that figure with what a repaired listing would clear.
